problem: Cabinet latches flex every time the door opens, and years of heat cycles in a parked RV make the plastic brittle. When one cracks, the door swings open on the road. Some makers have discontinued the shape, so a direct replacement may not exist.
oem_situation: The Newmar 020658A latch is discontinued. A printed version of it sells for about $24 elsewhere. We price from $22 for a typical simple latch, and the final figure depends on the shape.
our_part: We print in ASA, which holds up to the heat inside a closed RV in summer. We copy the profile from your photo, your broken latch or its mounting holes. We need a clear photo with a coin or ruler, the RV make and year if you know them, and any number stamped on the part.

how_to_order: Take the broken latch off the cabinet, or photograph it in place if the door is still on.
Send photos on the request page, with a coin or ruler in the shot and the model number if you have it. We reply with a quote within 24 hours on business days.
Approve the quote and we print the part, usually in 5 to 10 business days after approval, then ship it to you.

faqs.q: My latch is discontinued. Can you still make it?
faqs.a: Usually, yes, if we can see the shape and the mounting points. Send photos of both sides and we tell you in the quote if anything looks unmakeable.

faqs.q: Is a printed part as strong as the original?
faqs.a: We do not claim it matches the original. Printed layers are weakest where they pull apart, so we orient the print so the main load runs along them, and we tell you if a part is a poor candidate.

faqs.q: How do I measure or photograph the part?
faqs.a: Photograph the front, back and edge of the latch, and the cutout it sits in, on a plain background with a coin or ruler beside it. Send the RV make and year if you know them, and any number stamped on the part. If you still have a broken piece, photograph that too.

faqs.q: Will it keep a cabinet door shut while driving?
faqs.a: We cannot promise it performs like the original. A latch holds a door only as well as its design and the cabinet allow, so a spare latch is a sensible order for heavy cabinets.

faqs.q: Do you make metal strikers and screws?
faqs.a: No. We make the plastic latch parts only.
